name: MD Hybrid Adaptive Sigmas
plain: Single node with many modes, written as standalone formulas without reading the model's table. Several modes reuse core scheduler names for different curves, so results won't match core. Chunks can chain modes. The output usually ends at sigma_min, so a trailing zero depends on node options not read here.
math:
ays: L=logistic(10(t−.5)) normalised; c=.7L+.3e^{−2t}; σ=σmin+(σmax−σmin)(1−c/max c).
beta: b=1−(1−t^α)^β; σ=σmax(1−b)+σmin·b.
simple: σ=σmax−(σmax−σmin)(3t²−2t³).
sgm_uniform: linear in σ. ddim_uniform: σmin+(σmax−σmin)√(t/T) over integer stride.
bong_tangent: θ=tπ/4; τ=norm(tan θ); σ=σmax(1−τ)+σmin·τ; final σmin (not 0).
poly: linear in σ^{1/p}. blended_curves: (1−b)karras+b·linear. variance_preserving, exponential, karras_rho, kl_optimal, linear_quadratic (threshold 0.0025) also.
Smoother: Gaussian, EMA or moving average blended by strength.

props.params: steps, mode, denoise, rho, power, beta_alpha, blend_factor, threshold

label: from code
surprise: Mode 'ays' is a logistic formula with no AYS table, 'beta' is 1−(1−t^α)^β rather than Beta quantiles, and 'simple' is smoothstep: same names, different schedules from core (hybrid_scheduler_core.py:134-176).

audit.note: Formulas match, with omissions a reader would misjudge. ddim_uniform as coded is ascending: flip(1000−k·stride) rises, so σ goes σmin→σmax unless reversed (MDMAchine__ComfyUI_MD_Nodes/core/hybrid_scheduler_core.py:154-162). ays does not start at σmax: c(0)=0.3, max c≈0.74, so σ₀≈σmin+0.6(σmax−σmin) (lines 144-152). "Chunks can chain modes" refers to split_schedule with mode_b (schedulers/MD_HybridSigmaScheduler.py:418-422); memory chunks reuse one mode (core:188-203). Plain "ends at sigma_min": karras and kl_optimal end at 0 (core:56-74).
